cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
doc = json.load(open('tmp/stress.json'))
# pad with whitespace to just under 16 MiB
core = json.dumps(doc)
target = 16*1024*1024 - 10
padded = ' ' + core + ' ' * (target - len(core) - 2)
print('len', len(padded.encode()))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'submission/main.py'], input=padded.encode(), capture_output=True)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'out has error?', b'error' in p.stdout[:60], 'bytes', len(p.stdout))
padded2 = ' ' + core + ' ' * (16*1024*1024 - len(core) - 2 + 1)
print('len2', len(padded2.encode()))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'submission/main.py'], input=padded2.encode(), capture_output=True)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'out', p.stdout[:60])
EOF
